Name: animesugas' Toned Down Valley
Author: animesugas
Description:
[center][font=Arial][size=6][b]animesugas' Toned Down Valley[/b][/size][/font]

Hello! This is my first mod, and I'm super excited about it! Basically, I wanted to see if I could figure out how to use CP to make mods, and what do you know, I figured it out. By no means is it perfect - I am still working on it even now. I've redone it probably three times already, and I think I am finally satisfied with it. If anything bugs out, or you want me to match to something [i]that isn't already down below in progress,[/i] please report the bug and post your suggestions. I can't guarantee that I'll get to it soon, but I will try my hardest.

[b][size=3]Currently there are recolors for:[/size][/b]
- All main map areas (town, farms, etc.)
- Buildings
- Some crops, grass, & all trees
- Interiors
- Mines
- The mini-map that includes Ginger Island 



[b][size=3]Config options:[/size][/b]
- Interiors can be turned on/off
- Mini-map can be turned on/off
- UI can be turned on/off
(there aren't many UI options recolored tbh cause I use Overgrown Flowery and don't wanna part with it)
- Mines can be turned on/off



[b][size=3]Stuff that is coming:[/size][/b]
- SVE compatibility; currently the buildings and some sprites do not match. The map also is not the same, I am working on gaining permission for that. It will still show you  NPC locations if you have that mod installed, just not the correct map. Ex; Andy be chillin in the water.
- Ridgeside compatibility; this will be second after SVE.
- East Scrap compatibility; this will be third/come at the same time as Ridgeside.[/center]
